rules.name: Invalid SPID FormID
rules.description: The distribution target FormID is not a valid hex reference (0x[hex]~Plugin.esp) or known keyword name. SPID will silently skip or misparse this entry at game launch, causing the distribution to never fire.
rules.remediation: Correct the FormID to the format 0xFFFFFF~PluginName.esp, or replace with a valid keyword EditorID string.

rules.name: Zero-Chance SPID Entry
rules.description: The distribution chance is set to 0. SPID still parses and processes this entry at launch but will never actually distribute anything. Dead entries waste pre-menu parse time.
rules.remediation: Either remove this entry or raise the chance to the intended value (1–100).

rules.name: Unfiltered SPID Distribution
rules.description: All filter fields are NONE, meaning this entry distributes to every single NPC in the game unconditionally. This is occasionally intentional but is worth reviewing.
rules.remediation: If intentional, suppress this notice. Otherwise add keyword, race, or NPC filters in fields 2–6 to narrow the distribution.

rules.name: Invalid KID FormID or Keyword
rules.description: The keyword reference in field 1 is not a valid FormID (0x[hex]~Plugin) or a recognised keyword EditorID. KID will fail to inject this keyword at game launch.
rules.remediation: Correct to 0xFFFFFF~PluginName.esp or supply a valid keyword EditorID string.

rules.name: Unknown KID Object Type
rules.description: The object type field does not match any known KID object type. KID will reject this entry and skip keyword injection for it.
rules.remediation: Replace with a valid type: Activator, Ammo, Armor, Book, Clothing, Enchantment, Flora, Furniture, Ingredient, Key, Location, Magic Effect, Misc Item, NPC, Potion, Race, Scroll, Soul Gem, Spell, or Weapon.

rules.name: KID Broad Wildcard Filter
rules.description: The filter field is a bare wildcard (*), matching every item of the specified type. This applies the keyword universally and may cause unintended interactions with other mods.
rules.remediation: Narrow the filter with name patterns (*Sword, *Dagger), FormID references, or exclusion filters (-keyword) to limit the scope.

rules.name: SkyPatcher Malformed Plugin Reference
rules.description: A Plugin|FormID reference in this SkyPatcher config has an empty plugin name or empty FormID. SkyPatcher will fail to resolve the reference and skip this operation at game launch.
rules.remediation: Correct to the format PluginName.esp|FormID (e.g. Skyrim.esm|0003C21D).

rules.name: SkyPatcher Non-Hex FormID
rules.description: The FormID portion of a Plugin|FormID reference contains non-hexadecimal characters. SkyPatcher cannot parse this as a valid record reference.
rules.remediation: FormIDs must be hexadecimal only (0-9, A-F). Remove any typos, spaces, or non-hex characters from the FormID field.
